strategy: Pre-confirmed H1/H4 structural support/resistance: touch bounce and trade to next opposite zone

assumptions.levels: H1 3-bar, H4 2-bar confirmed swing pivots, .20 ATR prominence, no future data
assumptions.clustering: Same-side pivots within min(7,max(1.5,.18*H1 ATR)) USD; zone width min(6,max(1,.12*ATR)) USD
assumptions.strength: Strong if >=2 independent confirmed pivots >=6h apart OR >=1 H4 pivot. Weak = single H1 pivot
assumptions.invalidation: Closed H1 beyond pivot price plus width and .10 pivot ATR invalidates future touches
assumptions.expiry: H1 21d, H4 60d; approach from correct side; at most one side touched per H1; 6h level cooldown
assumptions.raw_bounce: First M1 touch, $5/$10/$20 move away before structural break; no same-minute favorable credit
assumptions.entry: H1 touches zone and closes beyond center (mid) or beyond far edge (strict), market next M1 open
assumptions.target: Nearest already-known opposite support/resistance zone boundary with .25 USD cushion
assumptions.stops: zone boundary plus .10 H1 ATR (min .50 USD), or beyond touched H1 candle wick plus same buffer
assumptions.costs: Dukascopy BID M1; synthetic spread .30 USD and .10 USD per-side slippage
assumptions.rr2: Planned net target/risk >=2, before entry; reports also no RR filter
assumptions.holding: 12h and 24h; intraminute stop-first, weekend gaps censored; no leverage/lot assumption
assumptions.holdout: 2026-08-16 onward, temporal last-quarter split, no fitting performed

caveats: Exploratory operational definition of strong zones; not market depth/actual resting orders.
Raw bounce rate is conditional on touching a pre-known zone; not trade win rate.
Historical spreads are approximated; minute OHLC has no intra-minute path.
A few concurrent trades can overlap; total R is gross sum, not a portfolio equity curve.
